query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tps_genes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  subfamily VARCHAR(50),
  product_class ENUM('hemiterpene', 'monoterpene', 'sesquiterpene', 'diterpene') NOT NULL,
  main_product VARCHAR(255),
  olfactory_notes TEXT,
  pathway ENUM('MEP', 'MVA', 'both') DEFAULT 'both',
  regulation_factors TEXT,
  expression_conditions TEXT,
  source_reference VARCHAR(500),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
